final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM patient_groups) SELECT pg.SEX, AVG(pg.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(pg.avg_diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(pg.avg_diff / o.mean_diff) AS avg_diff_ratio FROM patient_groups AS pg CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pg.SEX <> '' GROUP BY pg.SEX
